- [EVENT] User recently bought a limited edition Tom Ford perfume for $200.
- [EVENT] User saw a similar perfume at Target for $20.
- [PREFERENCE] User is questioning whether it's worth splurging on luxury perfumes or if there are affordable alternatives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros of luxury perfumes, including high-quality ingredients, concentration of fragrance, brand reputation, and packaging.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the cons of luxury perfumes, including steep price tags and limited accessibility.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested affordable alternatives, including niche brands like Byredo, Le Labo, and Jo Malone, as well as drugstore brands like Calvin Klein, DKNY, and Vera Wang.
